body.basis: ONE qualified decision -> PAPER and ACTUAL, as siblings. PAPER is SIMULATED: the paper order and its simulated fills. ACTUAL is the live venue: the separate retail account's order at the decision's target quantity / 1000 (nearest whole contract), submitted without waiting for the paper order, with fills read only from the venue's own order records. The two are never summed. A missing figure is null (shown as 'unavailable'), never zero.

status_definitions.closed: ended (cancelled or expired) with no fill
status_definitions.filled: ended with at least one fill (fully or partly filled)
status_definitions.open: not yet ended: planned, submitting, unresolved, resting or partly filled
status_definitions.refused: excluded before submission (with the reason) or rejected by the venue / simulator

decisions.basis: ONE qualified decision -> ONE execution intent -> PAPER (simulated) and ACTUAL (Polymarket retail) as siblings; the actual order never waits for the paper order
